One of the students claims that Judge 2 is awarding higher marks than Judge 1.
Carry out a Wilcoxon matched-pairs signed-rank test at the 5% significance level to test whether
the data supports the student’s claim. 
It is discovered later that the marks awarded to student A have been entered incorrectly. In fact, Judge 1
awarded 65 marks and Judge 2 awarded 62 marks.

parts.text:
By considering how this change affects the test statistic, explain why the conclusion of the test
carried out in part (a) remains the same.
